versions.name: Camp Everglades
versions.summary: A rustic South Florida Council camp set within Everglades National Park near Homestead, offering primitive campsites in pine rockland forest for troop camping and leader training.

sources.citation: Added 2026-08-14 (method: curated) from a coverage gap surfaced by the scout-camp-map project; council/status re-verified from the South Florida Council's own Camp Everglades page and council-at-a-glance sheet, which describe it as a currently reservable, seasonal 217-acre primitive camp within Everglades National Park. The source's council website (sfcbsa.org) resolves to the current sfcscouting.org domain and the street address was corrected to the council-listed 28400 Research Road. Coordinates from scout-camp-map (approximate; the in-park address did not geocode); elevation from open-meteo. Features unsurveyed; July normals pending a WorldClim resample.

provenance.notes: Coverage add: existence, council, and operating status verified against the council's own camp page; camp_type/program_types classified conservatively as a primitive camping and training property; features unsurveyed. Coordinates approximate.
